text:
Ellen K: urgent escalation for Meridian Bank POC. CISO says we need dedicated env + KMS with BYOK and a signed SLA before they pilot. They want pricing for a 6-month reserved capacity pilot.
Ravi P: what SKU/commit are they targeting?
Ellen K: they want 4xA10G equivalent. Budget asks: pilot credit then potential 12mo commit if pilot passes.
Sofia M: security questionnaire open items: key custody flow, network egress IPs, audit evidence (SOC2 report), and data deletion procedure. CISO is strict on retention windows.
Omar (Eng): BYOK flow is supported. I'll send a short diagram and steps. We can region-pin to us-east-1. Latency SLO for pilot?
Ellen K: they asked for 95p < 120ms for short prompts, but 99p for 2k tokens is requested for full rollout. Pilot can accept relaxed latency but want a formal plan.
Omar (Eng): for pilot sizing, 4xA10G should meet pilot 95p. For 99p at scale recommend 8x with burst. I'll include expected qps numbers.
Claire (Legal): we'll need their legal contact and a PO. I can draft a short pilot MSA + DPA. Any unusual redlines so I can preempt?
Sofia M: they might push on subprocessing: no third-party telemetry. Also on-data residency: us-east only.
Ellen K: I'll ask for their legal lead: "leah.carter@meridian.bank". Also confirm telemetry ask.
DeployBot: automated note - Dedicated deploy templates available at /deploy/templates/dedicated.yaml
Ravi P: commercial levers: offer 15% on 6mo pilot + one month free, escalate to 25% on 12mo commit. Need exec ok for deeper discount.
Ellen K: can we fast-track an exec review if legal/ops sign off technical answers?
Claire (Legal): yes, if Ops confirms no risky subprocessors and Eng signs the BYOK flow doc, I can fast-track. ETA for DPA draft: 24-48h.
Omar (Eng): uploaded BYOK diagram and egress IPs: /internal/eng/meridian/byok_egress.pdf. Also scheduling a 30-min tech deep-dive with their CISO tomorrow 11am ET.
Sofia M: I'll prepare the security Q responses and mark required evidence attachments.
Ellen K: action items: 1) Omar - BYOK + egress doc (ETA 6h) 2) Sofia - completed sec questionnaire answers (ETA 8h) 3) Claire - pilot MSA + DPA draft (ETA 48h) 4) Ravi - pricing proposal for 6mo pilot + 12mo commit fallback (ETA EOD)
Ravi P: looping in finance after this thread; will report back.
Ellen K: thanks team. I'll update Meridian after the tech call and post the meeting notes here. :thumbsup:
